root.name: Wizard
root.html: A scholar who masters magic through study and experiment. Pick an arcane school and an arcane thesis above, then your wizard feats.

group-school.name: Arcane School
group-school.hint: Pick one school. The School of Unified Magical Theory grants an extra 1st-level wizard feat.

theme-metamagic.name: Spellshape
theme-metamagic.html: Feats with the spellshape trait: they alter the next spell you cast — its range, area, damage or how noticeable it is.

theme-battle.name: Counterspell & Defense
theme-battle.html: Counterspelling, protective arrays and the senses and reflexes a wizard relies on in a fight.

theme-book.name: Spellbook & Slots
theme-book.html: Your spellbook, cantrips, scrolls and the way you prepare and recover spell slots.

theme-bond.name: Arcane Bond & School
theme-bond.html: Your bonded item, school spells and focus points. Every wizard has an arcane bond from 1st level.

theme-mind.name: Illusion & Influence
theme-mind.html: Illusions, words and performances that bend the minds of others.

theme-necro.name: Undeath
theme-necro.html: Uncommon feats for those who create or control undead (Book of the Dead).

theme-familiar.name: Familiar
theme-familiar.html: Your familiar and its growth. The Improved Familiar Attunement thesis also grants the Familiar feat.

group-school.name: Школа магии
group-school.hint: Выберите одну школу. Школа единой магической теории даёт дополнительную черту волшебника 1 уровня.

group-school.name: Арканная школа
group-school.hint: Выберите одну школу. Учение единой магической теории даёт дополнительную способность волшебника 1 уровня.
